scope_notes: Each positive receipt comes from the unchanged original conditional-body checker with its declared dependencies introduced as hypotheses.
The old95 controller supplies only exact current source/provider specifications. No saved observation, proof bundle or Alpha edition supplies conditional acceptance authority.
All negative bodies use the unchanged checker and genuine source table; failures are expected and tested, not mocked.
Common-right-divisor greatestness does not assert that an arbitrary Bezout representative itself divides A or B.
Input/output transport explicitly requires canonical replacement bounds and only a nonzero modulus. Both replacement proper products are constructed, and U,V are retained.
Terminal construction uses RightDivides(A,G), not the reversed relation, and constructs the empty coefficient's actual product with arbitrary canonical B.
No new gcd, Normal or NormalizedGcd definition is introduced here.
